items.title: Citigroup (C) Redeems Preferred Stock Following An Undervalued But Tested Narrative
items.summary: Citigroup (C) has moved to redeem all US$1.0b of its 4.150% Series Y preferred stock, retiring 1,000,000 depositary shares at US$1,000 each and ending dividend accrual on November 15, 2026. Citigroup’s move to tidy up its capital stack comes after a mixed stretch for the common stock. The 1 day share price return was 1.59% to US$124.21, but the 30 day share price return was down 5.84% and the 90 day share price return was down 10.47%. items.title: CNH Industrial (CNH) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Split Analyst Views
items.summary: CNH Industrial sits in the middle of an active debate, with price targets across the Street clustered between roughly US$11 and US$18 and an updated fair value estimate now set at US$14.70. This shift lines up with a split analyst narrative, where more bullish firms connect higher targets in the US$15 to US$18 range to their earnings assumptions, while cautious houses stay closer to US$11 to US$12 and point to execution and demand risks. items.title: Rising costs will not halt data center construction boom, Citi says
